response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN s.gbsize END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN s.spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), status_average AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute FROM status_rates) SELECT r.status, r.total_scans, r.gb_per_minute, r.gb_per_minute - a.average_gb_per_minute AS above_average FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN status_average AS a WHERE r.gb_per_minute > a.average_gb_per_minute
